messages:
sarah: paging: spike in 5xx for prefix /v1/generate/tenant/ across multiple regions. alerted by SLOs. seeing ~20% error rate at 1m windows :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-4821 created and paged oncall@sre-team
priya: customer-impact: support queue growing, a few customers reported truncated responses and 502 errors. sending heads-up to enterprise channel
mike: looking at runtime metrics — prefix KV miss ratio jumped from 2% to 48% and backend KV latency is spiking. suspecting cache index corruption or a hot write pattern.
jess: any deploys around the window?
mike: nope, no planned deploys. autoscaling normal.
sarah: priority mitigations: 1) throttle high-QPS tenants hitting prefix-heavy routes, 2) temporary KV cache bypass for correctness for affected prefixes, 3) route some traffic to a compatible model variant if latency goes above SLOs.
priya: holding comms: asking affected customers for request ids now.
mike: starting with throttle — incremental rate-limits to avoid client outage. hitting admin API:
```
# throttle tenant 1234 to 60rps
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/throttle -d '{"tenant":"1234","rate":60}' 
```
jess: preparing a runtime flag for prefix bypass. will toggle only for /v1/generate/tenant/
```
# runtime toggle
rbctl set feature.cache_prefix_bypass true --pattern "/v1/generate/tenant/*" --reason "incident 4821"
```
incident-bot: deploy-bot started a config rollout to runtime hosts (canary 5%)
deploy-bot: rollout stage=canary hosts=5 config=cache_prefix_bypass:true
mike: canary looks good for 2 min, no new 5xxs from canary host. starting ramp to 50%
sarah: on-call handoff: mike taking lead for mitigation, sarah will handle customer comms and priority escalation. @mike please update when bypass fully rolled. :white_check_mark:
mike: ramp to 100% bypass complete. observed KV error rate drop to 6% and 5xxs down to ~1.5% within 3m. latency increased slightly for those reads (+40ms) but within SLO.
priya: passing note to customers: "We applied a temporary cache bypass for a subset of requests to preserve correctness while we investigate a cache index anomaly. No data lost; expect slightly higher latency."
jess: collecting heap profiles and cache index snapshots from the runtime hosts for postmortem.
mike: adding traffic-shaping policy for noisy tenants: reducing burst window and enforcing per-route quotas. command:
```
# tighten burst windows
rbctl set quota tenant=54321 route="/v1/generate/tenant/*" burst=50 window=60
```
priya: support update sent. one enterprise account asked for rollback plan, they were notified that bypass is reversible within 2m and throttles can be tuned.
sarah: next: investigate root cause. hypotheses: 1) KV index corruption due to concurrent prefix compaction, 2) sudden hotkey (re-entrancy) generating large write fanout, 3) bug in prefix eviction logic.
jess: I captured logs from 12 hosts showing evictions flooding the write queue. saving to incident artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-4821/artifacts/evictions.log
mike: for safety we left bypass enabled. moving to scheduled rollback plan once we have a patch or confirm root cause. provisional rollback window in 2h.
incident-bot: reminder: oncall handoff in 50m if still active
priya: CS asked for incident severity. recommended SEV2 given customer impact and degraded latency.
sarah: agreed SEV2. assigning follow-ups: jess (runtime traces + repro), mike (metrics + mitigation validation), priya (customer comms + Affected list).
mike: added temporary exclusion for prefix compaction job to avoid concurrent writes during root-cause analysis. command executed.
jess: captured a minimal repro that spikes evictions using a script — saved under artifacts and posted in private thread with eng-ml to see if model outputs correlate.
priya: created a shared spreadsheet of affected accounts and support tickets. linking to incident doc.
sarah: closing note for now: service stabilized after cache bypass + throttles, monitoring for any regressions. full postmortem to include timeline, config diffs, and suggested hardening (better hotkey detection, safer compaction). will update channel when postmortem drafted. :memo:
mike: will leave bypass enabled until prod patch or tighter eviction backpressure lands. scheduling a follow-up tomorrow 10:30 PT.
priya: support to follow-up with customers with RCA draft.
incident-bot: INC-4821 status: mitigated -> monitoring
sarah: thanks everyone — nice work moving fast and coordinating comms. closing the slack thread when postmortem link is ready. :heart:
